# Pouch compatibility fixtures

Synthetic key-rotation formulas from Pouch commit
`d71d15c3a6de776fe4b8fddcdca10d6af6ac47f6`, MIT (see ../../../NOTICE).
Historical query `q000005` was SAT; `q000000` was UNSAT. These are stored inputs,
not a claim that this repository runs the Pouch planner or native integration.
Variable metadata is opaque to the generic solver. The test adapter must retain
and round-trip all original fields, including helper variables and time values.
